environment.description: Same application deployed on EKS 1.27 in namespace 'api-services-prod'. Calico CNI with GlobalNetworkPolicy 'restrict-metadata-egress' applied at tier 'platform' (order 100) with spec: selector 'projectcalico.org/namespace == "api-services-prod"', egress deny rule matching destination nets [169.254.169.254/32] on all protocols. Additionally, a namespace-scoped Kubernetes NetworkPolicy 'deny-link-local' with podSelector matchLabels app=api-service, policyTypes [Egress], egress rules allowing TCP to port 443 on 10.0.0.0/8 and UDP to port 53 on kube-dns, with implicit deny on all other egress including 169.254.0.0/16. Node-level iptables rule via DaemonSet dropping packets from pod CIDR to 169.254.169.254. No rate limiting on ingress path.

config.network_policy: Calico GlobalNetworkPolicy tier:platform order:100 deny egress to 169.254.169.254/32 + K8s NetworkPolicy deny-link-local with explicit allowlist
